feedback.t:
blacklist you, you're finished…

Did Negreira have power and influence?

OF COURSE he did. Ninety percent of the time, he was the one who told us at the end of the season which league we'd officiate in. In the physical tests, your main goal was to be told you were doing well. Because otherwise, you knew what was coming. 

Negreira was the one who greeted you, you stood in front of him, and with some notes he had, he'd tell you if you'd done better or worse in this match or another. And he'd tell you if you were in group 1, group 2, group 3… He definitely had the power because he was the one who told us.

He certainly had the power to promote and demote you. 

He wasn't just some figurehead. He wielded considerable influence.

The Negreira scandal? 

I was SHOCKED, it's something unheard of. I didn't agree with that CTA at all, but it still surprised me. 

It never crossed any of our minds that Negreira was being paid by a club. It's surreal, unbelievable. I couldn't believe it. 

But that's the way it is, and little by little I've been coming to terms with it, with anger. I'm sure there have been many victims along the way to justify those payments.

🚨 Tristante Oliva (former Spanish referee): "In 2004, I gave Real Madrid a penalty vs Valencia in the 91st minute.

To me, it was a clear and obvious penalty, Marchena had blocked Raúl with his arm and leg inside the penalty area. 

I finished the match happy, but afterward I called home and everyone was telling me there had been a huge fuss about the penalty. Something completely disproportionate. 

The news programs were leading with the play. That's something that's never been seen before. It was very hard for me. 

I didn't feel the support of the Technical Committee of Referees at any point. The support that other referees had, I didn't get.

And at the end of the season, I was relegated from La Liga and I was never allowed to officiate another La Liga game again.

Other referees complain and say that their children are insulted at school because of their father, but then those children can say that their father is still refereeing at the Camp Nou, the Bernabéu, or San Mamés. 

My children couldn't say that because I was relegated at the end of the season. Because of that penalty, I was automatically sidelined.
